sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Contract Research Organization (CRO) for Multinational Drug Trials

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France – United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (1967, as amended by the 2006 Protocol)
France – China Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1984, as amended by the 2013 Protocol)
France – Japan Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income (1995, as amended by the 2007 and 2015 Protocols)
France – United Kingdom Double Taxation Convention (2008, incorporating the 2009 OECD Model changes)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) provisions on freedom of establishment and cross-border services

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-1 through L. 561-58 and R. 561-1 et seq. of the French Code monétaire et financier (CMF), transposing EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843; Articles R. 123-209 et seq. of the Code de commerce for the beneficial-owner register; Décret n° 2016-1355 of 5 October 2016 on beneficial-owner declaration; Décret n° 2020-115 of 12 February 2020 on the prevention of money laundering and financing of terrorism; Commission on Money Laundering, Financing of Terrorism, and the beneficial owner register managed by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) under the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Registered Existence of any corporate founder or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company register of the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, if the origin jurisdiction is not party to the Apostille Convention, French Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (pouvoir) executed by each foreign founder or shareholder appointing the French signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French notary or recognized foreign notary public in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization, followed by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Individual UBO identification documents (passport or national identity card) and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization and certified French translation by a sworn translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of each corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the French SAS and the appointment of its president
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or shareholders' meeting of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization with sworn French translation if required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and proof of source of funds or capital contribution for the initial funding of the SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or credit institution of the founder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Sworn translation into French and legalization or apostille as applicable; bank confirmation to be directly verified by French counsel

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, officers, authorized representatives, counterparties and beneficial-owner declarations against the French territorial sanctions list (Gestions de gels des avoirs), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council sanctions lists, and, where the transaction has a US nexus, the OFAC SDN List. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are classified under Article L. 561-10-1 of the CMF and require enhanced due diligence with source-of-wealth documentation. Additional validation shall include real-time negative-news and legal-litigation databases of all directors and shareholders.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), administered by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) in coordination with the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and the local Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name may be in French, in a European language, or in a foreign language, but must be capable of transliteration into Latin characters. If the proposed name is in non-Latin script, a Latin-script transliteration is mandatory for the RCS extraction Kbis. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to a pre-existing company name in the RNE, a registered trademark, or a protected national designation. The corporate object clause must be written in French and must accurately reflect the CRO and clinical-trial-management activities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Laboratoire de biologie médicale without the applicable public-health registration
Hôpital / clinique without the relevant health-institution authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon official or unofficial rejection communicated by the INPI or Greffe through the Guichet Unique, counsel shall first classify the objection: (i) absolute identity, (ii) relative confusion with an earlier register entry, or (iii) protected-token deficiency. A revised name, if available, may be refiled through a new Guichet Unique dossier. If the viability of the original name is legally disputable, a formal 'recours administratif préalable' or challenge may be addressed to the INPI, followed where appropriate by an appeal before the jurisdictionally competent Tribunal judiciaire or, for decisions of a business registrar, the President of the Tribunal de commerce, within 8 days of the written decision unless a specific ministerial permission is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible only insofar as it consists of a French physical address maintained under an approved 'domiciliation' agreement (convention de domiciliation) with a commercial domiciliation company or the SAS president's personal residence. The address must be a genuine location in France where statutory books and corporate records are kept and can be inspected. A purely non-physical mailbox or digital-only PO box is not compliant with Article L. 123-10 of the Code de commerce.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; approximately 5% annual probability for a low-risk, white-collar professional-services entity. However, unannounced inspections are possible in connection with tax audits, failure to file annual returns, trigger events such as counter-party sanctions filings, or a commercial court 'période d'observation'. The company must maintain a physical registered office with legal records available within 24 hours.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability verification and preliminary RNE / Kbis conflict search for proposed SAS name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (official online search fees plus counsel's professional search)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory fee schedule of the INPI and prevailing market tariff for corporate counsel research

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and legal review of the SAS articles of association (statuts), including CRO and clinical-trial-management corporate object
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French corporate law firm / notaire in association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a French simplified joint-stock company customized to clinical-trial services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translation and civil-law certification of all non-French corporate and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator registered with the French Court of Appeal (Expert judiciaire)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Court-scale per-page statutory translator tariff and market benchmark for certified translations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of shareholder certificates, powers of attorney, and board resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Ministry of Foreign Affairs Apostille Bureau or competent consular office of the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official per-document statuary fees of the Foreign Ministry / Consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU consolidated sanctions, and UBO background screening of all shareholders and officers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance vendor and French law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for full-scope anti-money-laundering and sanctions database searches (a la Perry, Equiniti, or Thomson Reuters Economist)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet Unique / RCS registration fee for the SAS including beneficial-owner declaration and appointment of president
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce through the Guichet Unique portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the official RCS fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of the SAS incorporation notice (annonce légale) in a local legal journal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales approved by the competent Greffe
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Degressive regulated tariff per publication line set by the Ministry of the Interior

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office commercial domiciliation agreement, first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark, commonly 300 to 800 EUR per year for a professional-services entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIREN / SIRET INSEE registration and subsequent Kbis extract preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee and related courier/certificate delivery tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation escrow of initial share capital, if any, with a French notarial or bank account
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French notary or bank holding the capital-frozen account
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial scale fee and market bank account opening charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1 et seq. governing sociétés par actions simplifiées; Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. governing registration and the Registre National des Entreprises; Articles L.123-11 et seq. governing registered offices and business formalities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, with registration completed in the Registre National des Entreprises and the competent local Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés maintained by the commercial court registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic company-creation formalité submitted through the INPI Guichet unique, supported by executed SAS articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and required identification and premises documents. The former paper M0 form is generally replaced by the electronic formalité.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital applies to an SAS. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Cash contributions must generally be deposited with an authorized bank or notary before registration and evidenced by a deposit certificate. Contributions in kind must be fully contributed and may require a commissaire aux apports report, subject to statutory exemptions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accept the subscriptions for the shares set out in the executed articles of association and acknowledge receipt of the required paid-up cash contributions in accordance with applicable law. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [FULL FRENCH ADDRESS] and that all statutory and administrative notices be directed there until further resolution. RESOLVED, that [NAME] be appointed President of the Company for an unlimited term, with the powers provided by law and the articles of association. RESOLVED, that [NAME] be appointed Director of Operations and [NAME] Chief Financial Officer, each subject to the President’s authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm corporate structure, founders, capital, and regulated activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique guidance portal; competent commercial court registry for local filing requirements
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the SAS form, shareholders, beneficial owners, capital allocation, President, registered office, corporate purpose, and principal NAF activity. Verify that the corporate purpose expressly covers CRO management, clinical-trial coordination, data and regulatory services, and any laboratory or medical activities actually performed.
required_dossiers: Signed term sheet or capitalization table
Proposed corporate purpose and activity description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the activity description, corporate purpose, or ownership information before submission; obtain written regulatory advice where the company will perform laboratory, medical, pharmacy, or data-hosting functions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute articles and complete capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized French bank, notary, or other legally permitted capital depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the SAS articles and subscription documents. Open a temporary capital account, deposit at least 50% of cash contributions, obtain the certificate of deposit, and retain evidence of any contributions in kind and applicable valuation report or exemption decision.
required_dossiers: Commissaire aux apports report or statutory exemption statement, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve bank KYC queries, replace incomplete identification documents, correct the subscription schedule, and obtain a revised deposit certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Journal of Legal Notices (Journal d’annonces légales) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed incorporation notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, President, and registration details. Obtain the publication certificate and ensure the notice is consistent with the executed articles.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction or republication where the notice contains an omitted mandatory item, inconsistency, or typographical error; retain both publication certificates if republication occurs.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic application, upload the signed articles, publication certificate, capital deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, President declaration, beneficial-owner declaration, and identification documents. Electronically sign the application, pay applicable charges, and monitor the formalité dashboard.
required_dossiers: Journal of Legal Notices publication certificate
Foreign corporate shareholder documents, legalized or apostilled and translated where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond through the Guichet unique within the prescribed period, upload corrected or supplemental documents, and obtain confirmation of resubmission. If rejected, correct the stated defect and file a new or amended formalité; challenge a registry decision before the competent commercial court where legally appropriate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration and activate the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique, Registre National des Entreprises, and competent local RCS registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the registration extract and verify the SIREN, SIRET, RCS, registered office, activity, and President data. Provide the registration extract and tax identification details to the bank to release deposited funds and convert the account into the operating account.
required_dossiers: Registration extract or equivalent RNE/RCS confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction through the Guichet unique or the competent RCS registry for inaccurate corporate data; notify the tax authority, bank, and counterparties after correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-incorporation governance and compliance setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company records maintained by the President; tax and social filings submitted through the relevant French authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first shareholder and management resolutions, maintain the share register and transfer records, document delegated authorities, establish accounting and payroll controls, register as an employer if applicable, and implement GDPR, clinical-trial, pharmacovigilance, quality-management, and records-retention procedures.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Record corrective resolutions, amend internal registers, submit late or corrected tax and social declarations, and notify relevant authorities or clients of material compliance corrections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM), in coordination with the European Medicines Agency Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) and the relevant Comité de protection des personnes (CPP). The competent prefecture and DREAL apply where premises or activities fall within environmental or classified-installation rules.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Clinical trial authorization under Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, submitted through CTIS and involving ANSM and CPP review. A CRO generally does not require a standalone general manufacturing or industrial operating license merely to provide management services; the sponsor remains responsible for the trial and may delegate documented tasks to the CRO. Additional authorizations may apply to laboratories, pharmacies, biological activities, medical practice, or storage operations performed by the company.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, with the competent regional Direction régionale de l’environnement, de l’aménagement et du logement (DREAL) and prefectural authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt from a project-level EIA for office-based CRO management and administrative services. Laboratory, chemical storage, waste-treatment, animal-use, or other industrial operations must be screened under the French Environmental Code and may require case-by-case assessment or ICPE declaration, registration, or authorization.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-based operations have no process-specific wastewater or VOC threshold beyond municipal discharge, building, and waste rules. Any laboratory or industrial discharge must comply with the applicable prefectural or municipal permit, French Environmental Code requirements, wastewater acceptance limits, hazardous-substance controls, and licensed waste-transfer obligations. Hazardous waste must be segregated, tracked through the required national system where applicable, and transferred to authorized operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain premises fire-safety compliance appropriate to the building and, where applicable, établissement recevant du public (ERP) requirements; maintain emergency exits, alarms, extinguishers, evacuation plans, and fire-training records. Obtain landlord or building approvals for structural loads and laboratory installations where relevant. Complete occupational-risk assessment under the French Labour Code, establish a DUERP, provide required training and personal protective equipment, and arrange occupational-health monitoring. Additional inspections or approvals apply to laboratories, chemical storage, biosafety, controlled substances, and public-access premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) / French Tax Administration, via the impots.gouv.fr professional portal and the Chorus Pro government e-invoicing platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity conducting taxable French activities without a French permanent establishment must first appoint a fiscal representative or establish a local registered branch, then apply to the local Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) using the French forms (Cerfa 14416 and related registration filings). The application must enclose the foreign entity's constitutional documents, proof of registered office, certificate of tax residence, and valid non-French business registration. Upon validation, the SIE issues a French TIN and intra-community VAT number. For purely foreign-established service suppliers supplying cross-border B2B services into France, a simplified EU One-Stop Shop (OSS) or Reverse Charge mechanism may be applicable, but a direct French VAT registration is mandatory if local taxable supplies are made or if French VAT is invoiced.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not apply a check-the-box regime. The default is full corporate income tax (IS) at entity level for an SAS. Limited statutory options include the five-year preferential income tax (IR) election for newly created qualifying companies under Article 239 bis AB of the French General Tax Code (CGI), the group tax consolidation election (intégration fiscale) for subsidiaries held at least 95%, and specific hybrid mismatch adjustments required by the ATAD transposition; no general single-member transparency election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold for French-established businesses carrying out taxable supplies; registration is required from the first taxable transaction. The franchise en base de TVA exemption may apply only to established qualifying small businesses below approximately EUR 91,900 for goods and EUR 36,800 for services, subject to annual adjustment. For non-French suppliers making intra-EU distance sales or certain B2C OSS supplies, the pan-EU EUR 10,000 annual turnover threshold determines the place of supply; above this threshold or upon election, local French VAT registration is mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France has adopted a mandatory B2B e-invoicing and e-reporting framework. From the relevant reform deadlines (currently legislated for 2026-2027 waves), all B2B invoices must be issued in a structured digital format and transmitted through a certified Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP), a public portal or Chorus Pro. Real-time transaction data must be e-reported for French VAT, including invoice acceptance and payment status, through system-to-system APIs or the government portal. Digital signature requirements and VAT cash-flow clearing controls apply, with non-compliant invoices disallowed as input VAT deduction evidence.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For CRO services, French VAT is excluded (outside scope) where the supply is made to a taxable customer established in a third country or, in the case of intra-EU B2B supplies, is transferred to the customer under the reverse-charge mechanism. To claim the 0% effective rate or non-assessment on export-related clinical trial services, the supplier must establish that the recipient is a taxable person established outside France, that the service is effectively rendered, and that the invoice and supporting contracts accurately identify the foreign customer. For export of goods, the zero-rate exemption applies only where physical export to a third country or dispatch to another EU Member State is evidenced by customs export documentation and transport proof.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAE/ELISE DELTA X validation)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/FX transfer evidence of payment realisation
Commercial invoice and signed CRO service contract identifying the foreign recipient
Evidence of customer non-resident tax status (VAT ID proof or foreign tax residence certificate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration may recharacterise foreign supplies as taxable French services where the customer's status or effective establishment is not sufficiently documented. Improper export zero-rating leads to retroactive VAT assessment, input VAT denial, exposure to interest for late payment (intérêt de retard), the 40% deliberate breach penalty (manquement délibéré) or 80% penalty for fraudulent activity/abuse of right under CGI Articles 1728 and 1729, plus possible criminal sanctions for tax fraud under Article 1741. Export files are closely audited for real transaction substance, INCO term consistency, payment routing, and repatriation within the standard 180-day FX realisation due-diligence deadline.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France is France's central bank and participates in the Eurosystem. The French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) administers applicable financial and monetary regulations; the European Central Bank and applicable EU law govern relevant euro-area monetary matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France has no general foreign-exchange controls restricting conversion or cross-border transfers of funds. The euro is freely convertible for current and capital transactions, subject to EU sanctions, anti-money-laundering rules, tax requirements, financial-services regulation, and any applicable investment-screening or sector-specific rules. A French SAS may receive foreign capital and make lawful cross-border payments. Dividend and other profit distributions require legally distributable profits, corporate approvals, proper accounts, and applicable French withholding-tax treatment; treaty or EU relief may require eligibility and supporting documentation. Banks may require evidence of source of funds, transaction purpose, beneficial ownership, and tax status. Certain cross-border payments or transactions may also be reportable for statistical or regulatory purposes, depending on the parties, transaction, and applicable reporting thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no general statutory deadline for surrendering export proceeds and no mandatory conversion ratio. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency or converted, subject to accounting, tax, sanctions, banking, and any applicable reporting obligations. The SAS should retain contracts, invoices, shipping or service-delivery evidence, and bank records supporting receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and relevant regional Crédit Agricole caisse

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for routine payment execution, subject to the provider's licensing, permitted services, country coverage, and onboarding approval. An EU-authorized electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide payment services under its applicable authorization and passporting rights, but an EMI account is not equivalent to a bank deposit and may not provide statutory capital-deposit certificates, lending, or all trade-finance services. Confirm safeguarding arrangements, payment limits, settlement currencies, sanctions controls, and access to SWIFT or SEPA before use. An offshore digital EMI without an applicable EU authorization should not be treated as a compliant substitute for a French corporate bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No general French law requires every SAS director to appear physically at a bank branch for account opening. Banks set their own onboarding policies and may require in-person or video interviews, wet-ink documents, certified identity evidence, or local signatories. Remote onboarding may be available, but is not guaranteed, particularly for non-resident shareholders, complex ownership chains, or elevated-risk jurisdictions. A French bank capital-deposit account is commonly opened before incorporation; the bank issues a deposit certificate after receipt and verification of subscribed capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder, layered ownership, trust, nominee arrangement, or difficulty identifying the ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified constitutional documents and current company extracts for each relevant entity; ownership chart tracing natural-person beneficial owners; identity and address evidence; beneficial-owner register information; shareholder and board resolutions; explanation of control rights; and, where relevant, trust instruments or equivalent ownership records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital funding or operating receipts are inconsistent with the stated business, shareholder profile, or expected transaction volumes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or management accounts; recent bank statements; source-of-funds and, where requested, source-of-wealth evidence; subscription documents; investment or loan agreements; board approvals; tax filings; and a transaction forecast reconciled to the CRO business plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Clinical-trial activity, counterparties, or payments create concerns regarding sanctions, restricted parties, high-risk locations, or opaque clinical sites.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sponsor and CRO agreements; statements of work; clinical-trial protocol and site list; relevant French or EU regulatory and ethics approvals or submissions; counterparty and beneficial-owner screening records; sanctions-screening results; payment schedules; and documented controls for investigator, site, and participant-related payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value or unusual cross-border transfers lack a clear commercial purpose or supporting evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed contract, purchase order, invoice, deliverables or milestone acceptance evidence, beneficiary details, payment-purpose explanation, applicable tax documentation, and reconciliation to the ledger and approved budget.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The company requests an account before its incorporation details, registered office, directors, or business activity can be independently verified.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Draft or executed SAS articles; capital-subscription evidence; proposed registered-office documentation; identification and authority evidence for directors and signatories; incorporation filings or current Kbis extract when available; business plan; and CRO regulatory, quality, and operational documentation appropriate to the activities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For formation capital, obtain the bank's capital-deposit account instructions and transfer subscribed funds from an account in the investor's own name, identifying the SAS in formation and the capital-subscription purpose. Provide subscription records, investor identity and beneficial-ownership evidence, source-of-funds documents, and any requested corporate approvals. After registration, provide the Kbis extract and incorporation documents to release the funds to the operational account. For later equity injections, use a documented share issuance or other legally approved capital transaction and transfer funds to the SAS account with an accurate payment reference; retain subscription agreements, resolutions, bank advices, and accounting records. For shareholder or group loans, execute and document the loan terms and assess French tax, transfer-pricing, interest-withholding, thin-capitalization, and reporting requirements as applicable. Use SEPA for eligible euro payments and SWIFT for cross-border or non-SEPA transfers; provide truthful payment information and supporting documents. There is no universal French FX purpose code or mandatory currency-conversion instruction for ordinary commercial transfers.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments and SWIFT cross-border transfers for other currencies or destinations. SWIFT MT103 customer-credit-transfer messages may be used where supported; banks are transitioning to ISO 20022 messaging, so confirm the bank's current format and required fields. Match payments to executed CRO agreements, invoices, milestones, and deliverables, and retain evidence of service performance, beneficiary identity, tax treatment, and any withholding. Commercial letters of credit are available through banks where commercially appropriate, but are generally less suited to CRO service milestones than documented wire transfers; agree documentary conditions and fees with the bank before contracting. Screen payees and intermediaries against applicable sanctions and bank restrictions, and reconcile fees, exchange rates, and receipts to the general ledger.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards for identifiable forecast or contracted exposures, subject to bank documentation, suitability or appropriateness requirements where applicable, and internal treasury limits.
Non-deliverable forwards where offered for eligible currencies and counterparties; availability is subject to product classification, market restrictions, and bank approval.
Currency swaps for documented liquidity or funding exposures, subject to counterparty approval, collateral and valuation terms, and applicable EU derivatives requirements.
Spot foreign-exchange transactions for settlement of documented receipts and payments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: DABE - Annual Declaration of Beneficial Owners (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI Guichet Unique / Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) via the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 calendar days after the anniversary date of the company's RCS registration; also updated within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of EUR 15,000 and up to 6 months imprisonment for the legal representative for non-filing or false declaration; incomplete RNE record exposes the company to formal notice and administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements, Management Report and Statutory Auditor's Report (if applicable) - Dépôt des Comptes Annuels
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RNE via the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval of annual accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit with the RCS within 1 month of approval (calendar-year entity: usually by 31 July); extension available by court order
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal injunction from the registrar after 7 months following year-end; fine up to EUR 9,000 on the legal representative (Article L.247-1 C. com.); if no compliance within 1 month of formal notice, the public prosecutor may seek judicial dissolution; repeated non-deposit triggers administrative strike-off and loss of the ability to distribute dividends

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporation Tax Return and Statistical Annexes (Form 2065-SD and liasse fiscale 2052 to 2059-SD) - Déclaration de Résultat IS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques) via impots.gouv.fr
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year FYE 31 December: due by the 2nd working day after 1 May (e.g., 3 May 2025 for FY 2024); off-calendar fiscal year: due within 3 months after the accounting period close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late-filing penalty of 10% of the net tax due plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%; if no return within 30 days of a first formal notice, the tax base is assessed ex officio and increased by 40%; fraudulent concealment triggers an 80% penalty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: DAS2 - Annual Declaration of Fees, Commissions and Remuneration Paid to Third Parties (Form 2483? DAS2)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP via the e Déclaration / DSN portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March for paper filings and by the 1st working day after 1 May for electronic filings covering the preceding calendar year; applies to sub-investigator fees, R&D subcontractor honoraria, commissions and similar CRO pass-through payments
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or omission entails a penalty of 5% of the undeclared amounts (minimum EUR 36 per omitted statement); intentional concealment raises the penalty to 40%; the payee's taxation may be adjusted in parallel

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CFE - Annual Local Business Property Tax (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises) Declaration and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP (local service des impôts des entreprises) via the Gérer mon espace professionnel portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual declaration Form 1447-C-SD due by 15 June of the tax year for existing establishments; principal tax due by 15 December; a 50% instalment is due by 15 June when prior-year CFE exceeds EUR 3,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late declaration penalty of 10%; late payment surcharge of 5% plus monthly interest of 0.20%; continued non-compliance leads to enforced recovery via tax lien (avis de mise en recouvrement) and possible refusal of the local business licence; no direct RCS strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when the SAS exceeds, at the end of two consecutive fiscal years and before the close of the reference year, at least two of the three thresholds: (i) total balance sheet exceeding EUR 4,000,000; (ii) net revenue excluding VAT exceeding EUR 8,000,000; (iii) average permanent workforce exceeding 50 employees. A statutory audit is also compulsory when the SAS controls one or more companies and the combined group exceeds the thresholds, when the company is a public-interest entity, or when shareholders holding at least 1/10 of the capital request an audit in court
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts must be drawn up in euros under French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, including ANC Regulation 2016-06 on financial assets and liabilities and ANC Regulation 2015-06 on income recognition); IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted only for consolidated accounts of listed groups and is not permitted for the SAS's individual statutory financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must file the annual DABE confirmation within 15 calendar days after the anniversary of the RCS registration, irrespective of whether any ownership change occurred; the filing documents any person directly or indirectly holding more than 25% of capital or voting rights and any individual exercising control over the company. Any transfer of SAS shares must be reported by an updated DABE within 30 days of the transfer date and reconciled with the statutory share-transfer register (registre des mouvements de titres); failure to update after a transfer triggers the EUR 15,000 criminal fine
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des mouvements de titres (share transfer register, mandatory for SAS and subject to legal archival evidence)
Registre des processus verbaux et des décisions de l'associé unique (shareholder and president minute book)
Registre unique du personnel (employee register, kept at the registered office while employees are employed)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350-700 per annum for a third-party commercial domiciliation agent; USD 60,000-120,000 per annum for a physical CRO office or laboratory lease in the Paris region (recommended for GCP-compliant document archiving)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000-18,000 per annum when the statutory auditor mandate applies; nil below the legal audit thresholds (no statutory audit fee incurred)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs; R&D tax credit (crédit d'impôt recherche) up to 30% of eligible expenses; accelerated depreciation; tax losses carried forward indefinitely

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (Déclaration de résultat) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year end (e.g. 31 March for calendar year FYE 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only French-source income; substantiate with supporting invoices and contracts

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for business expenses including personnel costs and R&D
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard deductions apply; substantiate with invoices and employment contracts

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: €150 minimum to €75,000 maximum plus 0.5% per month of tax due up to 5%; evasion: 80% penalty on evaded tax plus interest and criminal prosecution

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and completed DTA relief form to French tax authorities for reduced rate application
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory rate, reduced to 0% under most treaties; Interest: 25% statutory rate, reduced to 0% under most treaties; subject to arm's length principle and economic substance

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50,000,000 consolidated group revenue for Local File obligation
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies OECD-aligned economic substance principles; CRO must demonstrate real economic activity, qualified employees, and core income-generating activities in France to avoid recharacterization or CFC rules

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 80% penalty on evaded tax plus interest plus criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for restitution, fines, and possible imprisonment; corporate veil may be pierced

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file TP documentation or apply non-arm's length pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €10 million or 5% of turnover; adjustments to taxable profit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for negligence or willful misconduct; possible disqualification from office

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: CRO operations lacking French employees or management without proper substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization as non-French entity; denial of deductions; potential CFC inclusion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal responsibility for compliance; fines and restitution obligations
